panel_subagent.title: SubAgent Configuration
panel_subagent.desc: Configure sub-agents for use with the SubAgentGeneration context modifier.
panel_subagent.output_help: Last Message: returns only the final AI message text. Full JSON: serializes the entire sub-agent interaction (AI + tool calls + results). None: sub-agent executes silently, no output is returned to parent.
panel_subagent.select_preset_hint: Select a preset from Generation Manager.
panel_subagent.private_tree_hint: This sub-agent has a custom modifier tree.
panel_subagent.minimal_hint: Runs with no system prompt or modifiers — just the task and tools.
panel_subagent.post_tree_hint: Execute post-generation pipeline on the sub-agent's LLM response before formatting output.
panel_subagent.post_tree_private_hint: This sub-agent has a custom post-generation tree.
panel_subagent.post_tree_minimal_hint: No post-processing: raw LLM response is used directly.
panel_subagent.delete_msg: Are you sure you want to delete "{0}"? This action cannot be undone.
panel_subagent.select_hint: Select a sub-agent from the list to start editing, or create a new one.
panel_subagent.sessions_hint: Every sub-agent tool call creates a persistent session. Browse or delete them in the 'SubAgent Sessions' panel.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.title: SubAgent Sessions
panel_sub_agent_sessions.desc: Each subagent_call creates a persistent session and returns its session_id for continuation. Sessions are grouped by sub-agent config; open one to read the full transcript, copy its session_id, export JSON or delete it.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.empty_hint: Sessions appear here after a subagent_call runs in a conversation.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.select_hint: Select a session on the left to view its details.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.index_error: Session index could not be read:
panel_sub_agent_sessions.loaded_missing: Session data no longer exists (it may have been deleted).
panel_sub_agent_sessions.export_failed: Export failed: session data is empty.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.delete_msg: Delete session "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
panel_sub_agent_sessions.delete_group: Delete all sessions of this config
panel_sub_agent_sessions.delete_group_ms: Delete all {1} sessions of "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
editor_subagent.select_hint: Select a SubAgent configuration from the list
editor_subagent.label: SubAgent
editor_subagent.no_configs: No SubAgent configurations found. Create one in the SubAgent Configuration panel.
subagent_config.basic_desc: Name, output mode, and stable identifier.
subagent_config.name_hint: Identifies the sub-agent in the switcher, nodes, and search results.
subagent_config.id_hint: Nodes reference this configuration by GUID; it never changes after creation.
subagent_config.pre_tree_desc: Use a shared preset, or keep a private tree for this sub-agent.
subagent_config.plugins_desc: Plugin panels enabled here are shown in this sub-agent’s session context.
subagent_config.empty_desc: Create your first sub-agent configuration, choose a preset, and save.
